classes.name: LIGHTS_ON
classes.description: Turn on vehicle headlights / exterior lamps

classes.name: LIGHTS_OFF
classes.description: Turn off vehicle headlights / exterior lamps

classes.name: GET_LIGHTS_STATUS
classes.description: Query whether headlights are currently turned on or off

classes.name: TURN_AC_ON
classes.description: Turn on vehicle air conditioning / climate cooling

classes.name: TURN_AC_OFF
classes.description: Turn off vehicle air conditioning / climate cooling

classes.name: GET_AC_STATUS
classes.description: Query whether air conditioning is active or inactive

classes.name: OPEN_DOOR
classes.description: Actuate servo to open driver, passenger, or both doors

classes.name: CLOSE_DOOR
classes.description: Actuate servo to close driver, passenger, or both doors

classes.name: GET_DOOR_STATUS
classes.description: Query door positions (open/closed state)

classes.name: GET_TEMPERATURE
classes.description: Read ambient cabin temperature via DHT22 sensor

classes.name: GET_HUMIDITY
classes.description: Read relative cabin humidity via DHT22 sensor

classes.name: GET_DISTANCE
classes.description: Read front obstacle distance via HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor

classes.name: GET_SENSOR_STATUS
classes.description: Perform full diagnostic telemetry readout of all connected sensors

classes.name: EMERGENCY_ON
classes.description: Activate vehicle hazard mode (flashing all indicator LEDs)

classes.name: EMERGENCY_OFF
classes.description: Deactivate vehicle hazard mode

classes.name: GREETING
classes.description: Polite conversational greeting to the voice assistant

classes.name: HELP
classes.description: Request available commands and voice capabilities

classes.name: EXIT
classes.description: Gracefully shut down or terminate the assistant session

classes.name: STOP_LISTENING
classes.description: Pause audio listening mode or mute the microphone

classes.name: UNSUPPORTED
classes.description: Out-of-scope or unsupported requests (media, windows, locks, navigation)
